# PortalActivateAfterEvent Class

> [!CAUTION]
> This class is still in pre-release.  Its signature may change or it may be removed in future releases.

Contains information about a successfully activated Nether portal, including its dimension, ignition location, and initiating player (when known).

## Properties

### **dimension**
`read-only dimension: Dimension;`

The dimension in which the portal was activated, not its destination dimension.

Type: [*Dimension*](Dimension.md)

### **location**
`read-only location: Vector3;`

The coordinates of the ignition position used to activate the portal. This is not necessarily the center or corner of the portal.

Type: [*Vector3*](Vector3.md)

### **player**
`read-only player?: Player;`

The player who directly activated the portal using an item, if known. Undefined for fire-based activation without a known initiating player, including dispenser-fired fire charges. Nearby players are not used for attribution.

Type: [*Player*](Player.md)
